label: Rewrite-based term search
description: Searches for rewrite-rule sequences that transform a source expression into a target expression using configurable search strategies (BFS, DFS, A*, beam search).

label: Equality saturation
description: Builds and saturates an e-graph from a set of rewrite rules to explore all equivalent forms of a mathematical expression simultaneously.

label: Hypothesis and rule-candidate mining
description: Mines candidate rewrite rules from successful transformation paths using anti-unification and pattern generalisation.

label: Counterexample and validation search
description: Validates algebraic identities and candidate rules by searching for numerical or symbolic counterexamples.

label: Proof workflow support
description: Supports proof-oriented workflows including critical-pair completion (Knuth-Bendix), Gröbner basis reduction and PSLQ-style numerical relation search.

label: Discovery path tracking
description: Records and replays discovered transformation paths with full reproducibility metadata for scientific benchmarking.

label: Checkpointable search-job persistence
description: Persists and restores running search jobs via a technology-neutral checkpoint port implemented by JSON in-memory and Hibernate/PostgreSQL adapters.

label: Web workbench
description: Browser-based workbench for interactive rule editing, search execution, proof review and experiment management exposed via a lightweight HTTP API.
